title: Text cache metadata fits again
summary:
A small text-cache tune-up: smaller metadata, precise path exclusions, and consistent HEAD lookups.

The text cache now stores a smaller set of response, request, and Cloudflare metadata to avoid R2 metadata-size failures.

Only `/models`, `/feed`, and `/openai/models` are excluded. Paths that merely start with those names can be cached.

HEAD requests now look up the corresponding GET cache entry and return headers without a body. Timing and metadata-size diagnostics were also added.
